supplies.text: You salvage a coin pouch and sealed medicine from the burned homes. The supplies here are exhausted.

survivors.text: You free Mira and two children from a collapsed house. They establish a camp west of Emberwood. Mira asks you to find her brother's silver locket.

mira_story.text: Mira remembers a sun sigil above the shrine. Her brother followed the old keepers into the ruins. 'If the Crown can be healed, let our village be the last to burn.'

herbs.text: You harvest the last healthy moonroot and brew two mana draughts. The rest must be left to regrow.

runes.text: The shrine's runes warn: the Warden was a protector, not a conqueror. Restore the Sun Sigil and learn the keeper's oath before touching the Crown.

sigil.text: You fit the altar's fragments together. The Sun Sigil answers with a pale dawn, gentle enough to hold in your hands.

archive.text: The last keeper's archive reveals the oath: offer the flame a home, never a throne. With the Sun Sigil, you may purify the Crown instead of simply burying it.

locket.text: In the flooded quarters you find Mira's silver locket and a final note: her brother stayed behind to evacuate the keepers. His kindness outlived the fire.

locket_returned.text: Mira closes the locket around her neck. The camp shares its savings and armor with you. A small part of the village has come home.
